S30.28.needs: a signed-in account and a chat that has produced a .pptx file (a deck the server created); a phone or simulator to see the share sheet
S30.28.note: A .pptx is only downloadable when the server created one (a remote generated file with an http(s) uri, handled in ArtifactFullScreen.tsx handleDownload, and the pptx mime/UTI is in apps/mobile/services/fileCreation.ts). The in-app export for a deck artifact offers only PDF, Markdown and Plain text (apps/mobile/src/features/chat/utils/artifactExport.ts), so PPTX is not a choice in the export sheet. Download button has no visible text, only an icon.
steps: Sign in and open a chat that has produced a PowerPoint file (a generated .pptx). Open its card so it opens full screen.
Tap the download icon in the top bar (labelled "Download artifact" for screen readers).
The app downloads the file and opens the share sheet with the file. Check that the file is a .pptx and that it opens as a presentation.
S30.28.where: Chat > open a generated .pptx file card (the artifact opens full screen) > Download icon in the top bar (accessibility label "Download artifact")
